props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit, and with an empty string after a send.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text and attachments. Return a promise to show the sending state until it settles.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Files waiting to go with the message. The caller owns the list.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Shows the attach button. Open your own file picker here.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls beside attach — an emoji picker trigger, a formatting toggle.

props.name: sendOnEnter
props.description: Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. When false, Enter adds a line and Ctrl/⌘+Enter sends.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit. Past it the counter turns red and send is blocked, rather than silently truncating a paste.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Tallest the field grows before it scrolls, in lines.

props.name: sending
props.description: Forces the sending state, for a send the caller tracks itself.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the text field.
